column1: # STRUCK FLIPS: listings whose flips are an INPUT ARTEFACT, struck from the flip backlog (identity-flip-backlog.tsv) by
# the owner's named decision. An artefact is a recorded input production no longer receives, so there is nothing for an
# owner to cure. The committed slices that hold it stay as the WITNESS of the mechanism they show, and their flips of a
# struck listing pass: IdentityDriftSlicesSpec (any seed) and PopulationMonotonicitySpec (any slice; neither a new flip
# nor a known row to cure). The drift explorer files no backlog row for one (scripts/ci/drift_explorer.py), and the
# drift gate says it struck, not "not in the backlog yet" (scripts/ci/drift_diff.py). Read by
# scripts.IdentityDrift.struck. ROWS ARRIVE ONLY BY THE OWNER'S DECISION (scripts/ci/commit_rules.py): a commit carrying
# `Owner-Approved: <YYYY-MM-DD> <decision and why>`, each row's decision `OWNER-APPROVED <that date>: <why>`. A row goes
# when no committed slice or pinned recording holds its artefact any more.
